args: cd /opt/codex-slack && WORKSPACE_ID=$WORKSPACE_ID MASTER_URL=$MASTER_URL TOPIC_ID=$TOPIC_ID exec python -m src.notes_mcp
notes.instructions: Provides persistent key-value note storage scoped to the current workspace and topic. Use these tools to read and write memory that survives across sessions. Always call list_workspace_notes at the start of a session to recall prior context.
